limits: Diagnostic PG table is admin-only, not an authenticated canonical repository or serving route.
Injected owner ACK gap follows a real PG commit; genuine wire uncertainty cases remain later integration.
Partial phase tests throw at awaited syscall boundaries; no process SIGKILL schedule is claimed.
Trusted local directory custody is required; hostile ancestor replacement, multi-host and power-loss durability remain unqualified.
Every-class E01-E04 and full AF-07/UX-01 acceptance remain pending.
